title: Basics of the Arduino IDE: Setup and Loop
summary: Explore sketch anatomy: the one-time setup() routine and the infinite loop(). Learn Verify and Upload.

steps.title: The Two Heartbeats: setup() and loop()
steps.markdownContent:
Every Arduino sketch has two main functions:
- `setup()` runs once when the board turns on.
- `loop()` runs continuously over and over forever!

steps.title: The Verify and Upload Buttons
steps.markdownContent:
- **Verify (Checkmark)**: Checks your code for typos and syntax errors.
- **Upload (Arrow)**: Compiles and flashes the program onto the board's flash memory.

steps.title: Serial Monitor
steps.markdownContent: `Serial.begin(9600);` starts a telephone line between Arduino and your computer. `Serial.println("Hello Monster!");` sends messages to the screen!
